description: This script manages the status LED behavior on a Linux-based device, providing functions to restore LED trigger states and set device states such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, and done by invoking specific LED blinking functions.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the default trigger for the status LED based on device tree information.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the device's status LED behavior based on the current operational state parameter.
